artifact.title: Geofenced Time‑Punch Validation Microservice Function
artifact.description: Implement a Python microservice function `validate_punch(employee_id: int, timestamp: datetime, lat: float, lng: float) -> dict` that validates that the punch is within 100 meters of the office location (latitude 12.9716, longitude 77.5946) and that the timestamp is between 06:00 and 22:00 local office time. The function must return a dictionary with keys `valid` (bool) and `reason` (string). The implementation must use strictly typed Pydantic models for input and output.
acceptance_criteria: When a punch is recorded within 100 m of the office and the timestamp is 09:15 local time, the function returns `{"valid": true, "reason": "Punch accepted"}`.
When a punch is recorded outside 100 m of the office, the function returns `{"valid": false, "reason": "Location out of range"}`.
When a punch is recorded within range but the timestamp is outside the 06:00‑22:00 window, the function returns `{"valid": false, "reason": "Time out of allowed range"}`.
